etsy.title: Toddler Recipe Cards, 20 Kids Cooking Cards with Picture Steps, Little Chef Badge Chart, Healthy Snacks for Kids, Printable PDF
etsy.description:
Your little one wants to help in the kitchen? These 20 printable recipe cards give them real jobs: wash, mash, stir, sprinkle – with numbered picture steps they can follow.

WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages)
• How to cook together + 8 Little Chef Rules
• 20 recipe cards, 4 per page (fruit skewers, banana oat cookies, veggie face toast, mini pita pizzas, smoothie bowl, apple donuts and more)
• Every card: 3 numbered kid jobs with icons, ingredient list, grown-up step, "Did we like it?" faces, notes lines
• Little Chef Badge Chart – color a circle for every recipe

PERFECT FOR
• Toddlers and preschoolers (ages 3+) with a grown-up
• Rainy afternoons, weekend breakfasts, lunchbox prep
• A sweet gift for a family who loves to cook

SAFETY
Oven, stove and knife steps are always grown-up jobs. Swap ingredients for allergies. These are simple family recipes, not nutrition or medical advice.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. US Letter + A4 PDF included. Print at home or at a print shop, as many times as you need for your family.

PLEASE NOTE
For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files. Colors may vary slightly between screens and printers.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
